observation.command:
docker exec workspace-postgres-1 psql -U daz -d daz -c "DELETE FROM email_otps;" >/dev/null
docker run --rm --network workspace_default curlimages/curl:latest -sS -X POST http://backend:4000/api/v1/auth/init-email-login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"client":"dashboard","emailAddress":"admin@schule.de","schoolSlug":"eckener-schule"}' -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n"
sleep 6
echo "--- mail.log ---"
docker exec smtp-sink sh -c 'cat /mail.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no mail yet)"' | head -50
